title: Spectra of Koopman Operators for Linear Maps
statement: For a matrix $A$ acting on the unit ball $U\subseteq\mathbb C^k$, how is the spectrum, and especially the point spectrum, of the Koopman operator $T_A$ on $C(U)$ determined by the spectrum of $A$?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Mini-Workshop: Applied Koopmanism (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/7, pp. 297--340](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2016/7)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** partially solved

**Assessment.** The report proves point-spectrum formulas for Koopman operators in several linear systems on a unit ball, but no general relation between the Koopman spectrum and the dynamics spectrum is established.
